newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - Aug 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - Aug 5.

text.p: These are the leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Financial markets concerned by dollar's surge to over 6.31 francs and 1.87 marks, highest levels since 1989.
-- Financial markets fear interest rate increases on both sides of the Atlantic.
-- Dutch airline KLM's new president seeks a European partner.
